Audience: first-time New Jersey Class D applicants, including teen GDL drivers and adults who will carry children as passengers.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the seat belt and child passenger laws set duties that fall on the driver [A01], and the vehicle-condition checks explain what a safe car needs before any trip [A06].
Level: rule recall with several look-alike thresholds (child ages, heights and weights, fines, stopping distance, tread depth, idling minutes); moderate load.
Prerequisites: the GDL restrictions from the licensing chapter, because GDL drivers carry an extra seat belt duty.
